title: Sustained Concurrency & Stability Harness for Distributed TP/PP Inference
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a reproducible, automated harness that measures sustained tokens/sec and p95 tail latency for multi-GPU distributed inference configurations (tensor parallel + pipeline parallel). The harness should focus on long-duration (30m-2h) steady-state runs to capture variability, warmup behaviors, and regression signals across model variants and quantization profiles. Outputs must integrate with our Grafana dashboards and trigger regression alerts in CI if tokens/sec or p95 regress beyond configured thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run fully automated 60-minute steady-state load tests for TP=2 PP=4 and TP=4 PP=2 on 8-GPU clusters
Measured metrics exported: tokens/sec (avg, 1m/5m windows), p50/p95/p99 latencies, error rate, GPU util, mem, KV cache hit ratio
Results are plotted to /grafana/dashboards/multi-gpu-stability and test artifacts uploaded to /s3/benchmarks/eng/ENG-30412/<timestamp>
A regression detection job in CI fails when sustained tokens/sec drops >8% or p95 increases >25% vs baseline snapshot
Runbooks and scripts committed to github.com/redwood-inference/multi-gpu-harness with README and example configs
Automated reproducibility: same seed/inputs + fixed traffic profile yields <3% variance in tokens/sec across repeated 1h runs
steps_to_reproduce: Watch metrics: open Grafana dashboard /dashboards/multi-gpu-stability, or tail results file s3://benchmarks/eng/ENG-30412/<timestamp>/summary.json
Run regression job locally: python ci/regression_check.py --baseline s3://benchmarks/baselines/multi-gpu/2026-02-01 --candidate ./results/summary.json
comments: 2026-02-10 Ava Martinez: Initial ticket created after two customer incidents showing p95 spikes under sustained load. Proposal: focus on steady-state and automated regression detection rather than single-shot peak benchmarks.

2026-02-12 Devon Chen: Prototype harness committed. Early findings: KV cache warmup causes ~12% tokens/sec variation in first 10 minutes — added requirement to include warmup phase and separate steady-state window.

2026-02-16 Priya Rao (Reviewer): Feedback - include GPU power and PCIe stall metrics; document reproducibility limits for sampling RNG and batching. Also suggested automated upload to S3 and tagging with kernel/driver versions.
2026-02-19 Devon Chen: Implemented telemetry exporter for GPU metrics and driver version tagging. Added stable traffic generator that replays request traces with timestamp alignment to reduce noise.

2026-02-23 Performance Sync Notes: Decided on thresholds for regression alerts after comparing three baseline runs: tokens/sec threshold set at 8% drop, p95 threshold at 25% increase. Rationale: balances false positives with real user-visible regressions.

2026-02-26 QA: Ran 1h steady-state for TP=4 PP=2 on 8xA100; observed p95 jitter correlated with kernel selection change when sequence crosses 1024 -> lowered sequence bucket to keep kernel stable. Action: add sequence bucketing guidance in README.

2026-02-28 Devon Chen: PR #128 merged with CI job that runs lightweight 10-minute sanity tests on each runtime build and a nightly 60-minute full test. Next: add canary alerts to Slack for early-warning on green builds.
